statement: Whenever min_moves(rooks) returns a result r, r is equal to the minimum, over all pairs of permutations sigma and tau of {0,...,n-1}, of the sum over i = 0,...,n-1 of (|rooks[i][0] - sigma(i)| + |rooks[i][1] - tau(i)|). Here a permutation of {0,...,n-1} is a bijection from that set to itself, and |.| denotes absolute value. Equivalently, r is the least total number of unit horizontal/vertical moves needed to move the rooks to a configuration with exactly one rook in every row and every column.
preconditions: Let n = len(rooks). The input satisfies: 1 <= n <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(rooks[i]) = 2, 0 <= rooks[i][0] <= n-1, and 0 <= rooks[i][1] <= n-1; and for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < n, (rooks[i][0], rooks[i][1]) != (rooks[j][0], rooks[j][1]).

statement: Whenever min_moves(rooks) returns r, r = 0 if and only if the n numbers rooks[0][0],...,rooks[n-1][0] are pairwise distinct and the n numbers rooks[0][1],...,rooks[n-1][1] are pairwise distinct (equivalently, the initial board already has exactly one rook in each row and each column).

statement: Whenever min_moves(rooks) returns r, let R be the minimum over permutations sigma of {0,...,n-1} of sum over i = 0,...,n-1 of |rooks[i][0] - sigma(i)|, and let C be the minimum over permutations tau of {0,...,n-1} of sum over i = 0,...,n-1 of |rooks[i][1] - tau(i)|. Then r = R + C.
preconditions: Let n = len(rooks). The input satisfies: 1 <= n <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(rooks[i]) = 2, 0 <= rooks[i][0] <= n-1, and 0 <= rooks[i][1] <= n-1; and for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < n, (rooks[i][0], rooks[i][1]) != (rooks[j][0], rooks[j][1]).

statement: Whenever min_moves(rooks) returns r and min_moves(rooks2) returns r2, r = r2.
preconditions: Let n = len(rooks). The input satisfies: 1 <= n <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(rooks[i]) = 2, 0 <= rooks[i][0] <= n-1, and 0 <= rooks[i][1] <= n-1; and for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < n, (rooks[i][0], rooks[i][1]) != (rooks[j][0], rooks[j][1]). statement: Whenever min_moves(rooks) returns r, let xs be the nondecreasing sort of the list [rooks[i][0] | 0 <= i < n] and ys be the nondecreasing sort of the list [rooks[i][1] | 0 <= i < n]. Then r = sum over i = 0,...,n-1 of (|xs[i] - i| + |ys[i] - i|).
